mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memory_import_source (tenant_id, agent_id, target_store_id, provider_family, logical_path, installation_fingerprint, last_observed_sanitized_sha256, last_imported_sanitized_sha256, last_observed_executor_id, last_seen_at, status, version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{agentId}, #{targetStoreId}, #{providerFamily}, #{logicalPath}, #{installationFingerprint}, #{lastObservedSanitizedSha256}, #{lastImportedSanitizedSha256}, #{lastObservedExecutorId}, #{lastSeenAt}, #{status}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), last_observed_sanitized_sha256 = COALESCE(VALUES(last_observed_sanitized_sha256), last_observed_sanitized_sha256), last_observed_executor_id = VALUES(last_observed_executor_id), last_seen_at = VALUES(last_seen_at), status = CASE WHEN status IN ('PAUSED', 'RETIRED', 'RECURATE_REQUESTED') THEN status WHEN VALUES(status) IN ('MISSING', 'TOO_LARGE') THEN VALUES(status) WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' AND VALUES(status) = 'OBSERVED' THEN status WHEN status IN ('MISSING', 'TOO_LARGE', 'STALE') AND VALUES(status) = 'OBSERVED' AND last_imported_sanitized_sha256 IS NOT NULL THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE VALUES(status) END, version = version + 1
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM memory_import_source WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{sourceId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memory_import_snapshot (tenant_id, source_id, sanitized_content_sha256, sanitized_content, byte_size, source_modified_at, scan_summary_json, status) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{sourceId}, #{sanitizedContentSha256}, #{sanitizedContent}, #{byteSize}, #{sourceModifiedAt}, #{scanSummaryJson}, #{status})

INSERT INTO memory_import_receipt (tenant_id, agent_id, source_id, snapshot_id, sanitized_content_sha256, curation_dispatch_id, outcome, target_versions_json, redaction_count) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{agentId}, #{sourceId}, #{snapshotId}, #{sanitizedContentSha256}, #{curationDispatchId}, #{outcome}, #{targetVersionsJson}, #{redactionCount})

INSERT INTO memory_import_receipt (tenant_id, agent_id, source_id, snapshot_id, sanitized_content_sha256, curation_dispatch_id, outcome, target_versions_json, redaction_count) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{agentId}, #{sourceId}, #{snapshotId}, #{sanitizedContentSha256}, #{curationDispatchId}, #{outcome}, #{targetVersionsJson}, #{redactionCount}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), source_id = VALUES(source_id), snapshot_id = VALUES(snapshot_id), curation_dispatch_id = VALUES(curation_dispatch_id), outcome = VALUES(outcome), target_versions_json = VALUES(target_versions_json), redaction_count = VALUES(redaction_count)
mapper.update: UPDATE memory_import_source SET last_imported_sanitized_sha256 = #{sanitizedContentSha256}, status = 'ACTIVE', version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{sourceId}
UPDATE memory_import_snapshot SET status = #{status} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{snapshotId}

UPDATE memory_import_snapshot SET status = 'QUEUED', curation_lease_id = NULL, curation_lease_until = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{snapshotId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND curation_lease_id = #{leaseId}

UPDATE memory_import_snapshot SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', curation_lease_id = NULL, curation_lease_until = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{snapshotId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND curation_lease_id = #{leaseId} AND curation_lease_until > #{now}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM memory_import_receipt WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND agent_id = #{agentId} AND sanitized_content_sha256 = #{sanitizedContentSha256} AND outcome = 'SUCCEEDED' LIMIT 1
